jobs.title: Senior Health Scientist, Environmental Health
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

**Work Type:** Ongoing - Full-time

**Salary:** $116,413 - $140,849

**Grade:** VPS 5

**Occupation:** Science and research

**Location:** Melbourne - CBD and Inner Metro suburbs

**Reference:** VG/1957703

The Department of Health plays a critical role in the Victorian health system and is responsible for shaping it to meet the health needs of all Victorians. We¿re focused on
  
supporting Victorians to be as healthy as they can; whether through alerting them to seasonal risks like thunderstorm asthma, notifying them of contact with
  
communicable diseases, safeguarding their drinking water, developing the best health, wellbeing and care facilities in the world, being at the forefront of mental health and
  
wellbeing treatment or accelerating medical research. It¿s all part of the way we partner with the community to help every individual lead a healthy life.

**About the role:**

The Environmental Public Health and Water team supports Victoria's Chief Health Officer Group in providing specialist expertise on the public health impacts of environmental hazards. The work is interesting and diverse and can involve dealing with unusual and unexpected or emerging environmental hazards and scenarios. The team provides advice on risk management, policy options and complex environmental public health issues, working under the Public Health and Wellbeing Act 2008, Public Health and Wellbeing Regulations 2019, Safe Drinking Water Act 2003, Safe Drinking Water Regulations 2025 and Health (Fluoridation) Act 1973.

This position is responsible for providing specialist health risk advice typically relating to environmental hazards, developing and implementing policies, supporting and/or co-ordinating the response to issues, investigations, incidents and emergencies, and for contributing to state and national level environmental health-related policies and guidelines. It also supports relevant national committees and management and leadership responsibilities when required.

**About us:**

At the Victorian Department of Health we want a future where Victorians are the healthiest people in the world. A Victoria where our children and people thrive, our workplaces are productive and safe, and our communities are more connected.

We see it as our job to support Victorians to stay healthy and safe. And to deliver a world-class healthcare system that ensures every single Victorian can access safe, quality care that leads to better health outcomes for all.

**About you:**

**Qualifications / Specialist Expertise:**

* A tertiary qualification in fields related especially to toxicology, or to environmental public health or health and environmental sciences is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated knowledge of risks to human health from environmental hazards and expertise in risk assessment, risk communication and risk management.

**What we offer:**

* The opportunity to perform meaningful work, making direct contributions toward enabling Victorians to be the healthiest people in the world.
* A wide range of growth and development opportunities within the department and wider Victorian Public Service.
* A strong commitment to work-life balance, including a diverse array of flexible working arrangements.

**How to apply:**

Applications should include a resume and a cover letter. Click the ‘Apply' button to view further information about the role including key contact details and the advertisement closing date.

We are committed to developing and supporting a workforce that is well equipped and highly motivated to provide responsive and quality services to all Victorians. We continue to build an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity of backgrounds and differences to realise the potential of our employees for innovation and delivering services aimed at enhancing the lives of all Victorians. All roles can be worked flexibly and we encourage applications from Aboriginal people, people with disability, LGBTIQ+ and people from culturally diverse backgrounds. Please contact us if you require any adjustments to participate in the recruitment process at inclusion@health.vic.gov.au. For more information on our commitment to inclusion and diversity see inclusion and diversity at the Department of Health.

If you have any queries in relation to participation in recruitment processes at Health, or experience any issues in applying, please feel free to email talentacquisition@health.vic.gov.au. Please note that unsolicited applications from third parties cannot be accepted. If you have questions regarding the role, please message the contact person listed on the advertisement directly.

Preferred applicants may be required to complete a police check and other pre-employment checks. Information provided will be treated in line with our Privacy Policy.

Applications close Monday 30 November 2026 at 11.59pm

Posted

16 November 2026

jobs.title: Head of Environmental Monitoring, Analytics and Insights
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

**Work Type:** Ongoing - Full-time

**Salary:** $193,946 - $263,771

**Grade:** VPS 7

**Occupation:** Science and research

**Location:** Melbourne - Northern suburbs

**Reference:** 1834

**Role details:** Ongoing, full time | VPS 7 | $193,946 to $263,771 + 12% superannuation | Ernest Jones Drive in Macleod, VIC 3085

  

* **Lead environmental monitoring, analytics and insights**
* **Modernise EPA’s science, digital and AI capability**
* **Turn complex evidence into actionable regulatory insights**
  

**About the organisation**

Environment Protection Authority Victoria (EPA) is Victoria’s independent environmental regulator, working to prevent and reduce the harmful effects of pollution and waste on communities and the environment. Operating under the Environment Protection Act 2017, EPA works with communities, government and industry to protect human health and the environment through proactive, risk-based regulation.

  

**About the role**

As Head of Environmental Monitoring, Analytics and Insights, you will lead the modernisation of EPA’s environmental and public health monitoring, analytics and insights functions. Reporting to the Chief Environmental Scientist, you will establish and lead EPA’s Science Digital Enablement Strategy, strengthening the organisation’s ability to collect, manage, analyse, forecast and communicate evidence about risks arising from pollution and waste.

  

You will build and lead the Environmental Monitoring, Analytics and Insights Branch as EPA’s centre of capability for environmental monitoring, forecasting, field investigation, emergency response, surveillance, sensor innovation, digital products and environmental intelligence. You will establish enterprise-wide frameworks and standards, strengthen scientific integrity and quality assurance, and guide the responsible adoption of emerging technologies, including data, digital tools and AI.

  

Working across EPA and with government, academia, industry, research organisations and technology providers, you will develop the partnerships, infrastructure and innovation ecosystems needed to support evidence-based regulation and EPA’s future Centre of Excellence for Regulatory Science and Innovation.

  

**About you**

You are an accomplished senior leader with experience leading complex scientific, digital, environmental, public health, emergency or regulatory functions. You have successfully established or modernised multidisciplinary capabilities, operating models, governance frameworks, digital strategies or science programs within a complex public sector, regulatory or scientific environment.

  

You understand how to translate strategy into practical roadmaps, governance arrangements, digital products and measurable outcomes. You bring experience leading data, AI, digital or analytics modernisation and can ensure scientific evidence is accessible and useful while protecting its quality, independence and integrity.

  

A credible and influential communicator, you build strategic partnerships, negotiate complex outcomes and communicate scientific, environmental and public health issues clearly to executives, governing boards, government, partners and the community. You will bring sound judgement, strong people leadership and a commitment to building a high-performing, collaborative and accountable culture.

  

**To see the full position description:** **Click Here**

  

**How to apply**

Click **‘Apply’** to submit your application, including a cover letter addressing your experience, the key selection criteria, motivations and suitability for the role, and a resume including contact details for two referees.

  

**Applications close Sunday 29 November 2026 at 11:59pm.**

Applications close Sunday 29 November 2026 at 11.59pm

jobs.description:
AI Job Summary

* 10+ years delivering large-scale technology transformation programs in complex enterprise environments.
* Experience delivering cybersecurity remediation, security uplift, risk management, or control improvement initiatives.
* Experience with IAM, RBAC, privileged access management, and least-privilege principles.

Sign up or log in to analyse my fit

### **Role Type**

Permanent • Full-time • Mid-level Senior

### **Description**

**“OTIC” means smart people doing smart work, together.**

We are a wholly owned Australian company based in Melbourne, committed to helping our clients design, secure and modernise technology platforms that unlock value across their business.

Otic Group was founded to give talented technology professionals the opportunity to work alongside some of Australia’s most recognised organisations while collaborating with exceptionally skilled peers in a highly supportive, ambitious and fast-growing environment.

Our expertise spans Project Delivery, Data & Analytics, Cloud Strategy, Application Modernisation and Cybersecurity, with consultants working on complex programs that deliver meaningful and measurable outcomes for our clients.

As demand for our cyber and technology transformation services continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced **Senior Business Analyst – Cyber Incident Remediation** to join our permanent consulting team.

**About the Role**

This role sits at the intersection of cyber security, business transformation and technology delivery.

You will play a key role in driving remediation initiatives arising from cyber incidents, security assessments, audits and risk reviews. Working across multiple technology and business teams, you will translate findings into clear business and technical requirements, remediation backlogs, measurable acceptance criteria and successful delivery outcomes.

The scope of work spans enterprise platforms including Salesforce CRM, Marketing Cloud, Tableau, Enterprise Data Platforms, Microsoft 365 and identity and access management solutions. You will work closely with cyber security specialists, architects, platform engineers, application owners, data teams and senior business stakeholders to uplift security controls and strengthen governance practices across the organisation.

This is an ideal opportunity for a Senior Business Analyst who enjoys solving complex problems, challenging assumptions and driving outcomes in large-scale, fast-paced environments.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Translating cyber incident findings, security assessments and audit recommendations into actionable business and technical requirements.
* Leading requirements elicitation workshops across business, cyber and technology teams.
* Defining remediation actions, user stories, traceability artefacts and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Conducting current-state and future-state analysis, process mapping and gap assessments.
* Working across Salesforce, identity and access management, Microsoft 365 governance, data platforms and monitoring capabilities to improve security controls.
* Supporting Agile delivery teams through backlog management, refinement sessions, testing and UAT activities.
* Identifying control gaps and working with stakeholders to drive agreed remediation outcomes.
* Collaborating with platform and engineering teams to implement sustainable solutions aligned to security and governance objectives.

**What We’re Looking For**

You will bring extensive Business Analysis experience gained across complex enterprise technology environments, along with a strong background delivering cyber security remediation or security uplift initiatives.

We’re particularly interested in professionals who can demonstrate:

* 10+ years of Business Analysis experience delivering large-scale technology transformation programs.
* Proven experience delivering cyber security remediation, security uplift, risk management or control improvement initiatives.
* Strong capability translating incident findings, audit recommendations and security assessments into clear requirements and implementation plans.
* Experience working with Identity & Access Management (IAM), role-based access control (RBAC), privileged access management and least-privilege principles.
* Advanced requirements elicitation, process modelling, gap analysis and acceptance criteria definition skills.
* Experience defining requirements for security logging, monitoring, detection and reporting capabilities.
* Strong understanding of data governance, information protection, privacy obligations and management of sensitive information.
* The ability to engage effectively with cyber security specialists, architects, engineers, data teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong Agile delivery experience, including user stories, backlog development, requirements traceability and test support.
* A proactive, self-starting approach with the confidence to challenge assumptions, identify risks and drive outcomes with minimal direction.

**Highly Desirable Experience**

Exposure to one or more of the following will be highly regarded:

* Salesforce CRM and/or Marketing Cloud security and access management.
* Microsoft 365 governance and Microsoft Purview.
* SIEM, SOC or enterprise security monitoring environments.
* IAM, PAM, passwordless authentication and passkey implementations.
* Tableau, enterprise data platforms or analytics environments.
* Security incident response programs or regulator/audit-driven remediation initiatives.

**Why Join Otic?**

At Otic, you’ll work alongside highly capable consultants who are passionate about delivering exceptional outcomes for our clients. You’ll gain exposure to complex enterprise environments, leading technologies and challenging transformation initiatives while being supported by a team that genuinely values collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.
